## 状态转换：`pm:awaiting-maintainer` → `needs-user-decision`（2026-09-09）

维护者回批逐字：**「B 桶 · 要你的判断，应转 needs-user-decision —— 23 张 转决策卡」**。

**判据**：欠**判断**不是动作 —— **指令面裁决**，且卡面标题自己就以 `[maintainer]` 开头、以问号结尾：「`AGENTS.md` 该不该写入『一个「已验证」的说法只和那个每次提交都重新验证它的检查一样可靠』这条规则？」本轮实测了五个实例作为证据。⇒ 纯裁决，⛔ 无可执行动作。

按 objectstack `SKILL.md:110`/`:126`：决定待做 = `needs-user-decision`。⇒ 此前为误分类 —— 它从一开始就该在收件箱。

同笔摘 `pm:awaiting-maintainer`；`domain:devx`、`documentation`、`priority:p3` 留下。

⚠️ 根因见 objectstack **#17017**。

## 维护者速读

**事情**:要不要把「一个『已验证』的说法,只和那个每次提交都重新验证它的检查一样可靠」写进 objectui 的 `AGENTS.md`。本轮实测五个同形实例:文档片段声称「已对照 dist 检查」而门禁结构上从不编译它;「52 个 chunk」三种数字并存;修复清单逐条过期;「184 页」是对一个已不存在的扫描面的**精确正确**计数(抽查会确认它、仍然错)。规则已逐字钉在 `scripts/check-doc-snippet-types.mjs` 头部并有测试;问的只是要不要也进 `AGENTS.md`,让不改那道门的作者也看到。

**选项**:**A(推荐)** 写进 `AGENTS.md`:一句原则,加仓里已三次独立收敛出的固定形状——「声明已验证时,指向那件仪器(脚本 / 测试),不写数字或断言」;受管草案 PR,人合。**B** 不写,规则留在门禁头部。**C** A 加 objectstack 侧镜像——另一仓另一卡。

**你要做的**:回一个字母,A / B / C。

<!-- os-decision-facets -->
- ① 项目长远合理性:A 把一条反复被重新发现的原则成文,减少逐次重学;B 让它只对读那个脚本的人可见。
- ② 实际业务拉动:五次实测,一轮之内。
- ③ 防 AI 犯错:AI 最爱写「已验证」加一个数字,这条规则正对着它;指向仪器的形状让断言可机器重验。
- ④ 创业阶段不扩散:一句话,零机制。
推荐 A(回退 B)。置信缺口:措辞由 devx / skills 席起草,您在受管 PR 上定稿。

## 裁后执行
- **A** ⇒ objectui `domain:devx` 回 `pm:queue`(受管面:draft-only、契约复审档复核、人合)。
- **B** ⇒ 关 not planned。
- **C** ⇒ 同 A,并在 objectstack 立镜像卡(`domain:skills`)。

## Ruling recorded — A: `AGENTS.md` carries the rule, in the pointer-to-instrument shape (director seat, summon #20, decision batch #108 item 5, 2026-09-09T05:4xZ)

**Provenance (who / verbatim / where):** maintainer, live PM chat with this seat (`session_01Tep4AYXZvyBA7jsvne5KZV`, `os-bill`), 2026-09-09T05:4xZ, replying to batch #108 in which this card was item 5 with the 速读 and four-facet block at 5596359882 recommending **A**. Reply, verbatim: 「7424 查 「什么在飞」 就应该查open的呀，直接关闭。 其他同意。」 — item 5 = **A**.

**Ruled.** objectui's `AGENTS.md` gains one rule — a claim that something was verified is only as good as the check that re-verifies it on every commit — stated in the shape the repo has converged on three times: when declaring something verified, point at the instrument (the script or test that re-derives it), never write the number or the assertion itself. B (leave it in the gate header only) and C (mirror in objectstack now) not taken; an objectstack mirror is a separate card if wanted.

**Execution.** Card → `pm:queue` in `domain:devx` in one write. Dispatch shape: governed surface (`AGENTS.md`) ⇒ draft-only PR, `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review of the wording, the terminal四件套 (review on the card, `needs-user-decision` + 「维护者速读」 on the PR, review requested from `os-zhuang` / `hotlong`, human merge); the five measured instances (objectui#7505, #7528, #7362, #7433, #7448) are the PR body's evidence; `skip-changeset`. The maintainer finalises the wording on the PR.

## Serialised behind objectui#7800 on the `AGENTS.md` hot file — ⛔ not shelved

`domain:devx@objectui` PM seat (`session_01FhBNJcLRZLe8M87VcUgpKr`), 2026-09-10T08:52Z. ⛔ No label, assignee or claim changes with this comment; this card stays exactly as the director seat's ruling (5596414669) left it: **ruled A**, `pm:queue`, unassigned, this seat's lane.

**Why it is not being dispatched in this batch.** objectui#7800 was claimed and dispatched at 08:50Z (claim 5615853758). It lands in the same file this card lands in — root `AGENTS.md` — and same-file cards are hard-serialised across rounds.

**The fold-or-serial question, answered rather than defaulted.** Both cards land one edit in one governed file with the identical PR shape, so folding them into a single PR was the cheaper-looking option. It fails **gate ①** (same defect shape *and* same fix — ⛔ not the same file, not the same subsystem, not the same keyword):

| | objectui#7800 | this card |
|:--|:--|:--|
| defect | a sentence in `AGENTS.md` asserts an equivalence that measurement falsified twice | `AGENTS.md` lacks a general rule that authors keep re-discovering |
| fix | narrow the assertion to what is true today, plus the corrective rule about rooting a test's reads at `import.meta.url` | add one principle, in the pointer-to-instrument shape |
| verifiable by | the two measured instances (#7791 / PR #7796, #7799 / PR #7806) | the five measured instances (#7505, #7528, #7362, #7433, #7448) |

Same file, same terminal shape, ⛔ **different defect and different fix** ⇒ **serial**.

## ⚠️ The pit this card inherits, recorded now rather than at dispatch

objectui#7800's PR is a **governed-surface** PR: draft-only, `needs-user-decision`, human merge. ⛔ No seat can move it, so its head stops moving on a **human's** clock, not on a queue's. ⇒ this card's dispatch waits on a human merge it does not control.

⇒ **The fence, stated in advance:** this card is dispatched when objectui#7800's PR has stopped moving — merged, or closed. If that wait runs long enough that this card is the only thing left in this lane's queue, the seat re-prices it rather than idling on it: the two edits are in **different sections** of `AGENTS.md`, so a second PR opened off the first one's merged base is a clean rebase, ⛔ never a manual conflict-ordering exercise.

⚠️ ⭐ One fact for whoever writes this card's wording: objectui#7800's own defect is a **worked instance of this card's rule** — 「和 CI 同一个结论」 was true when written (a claim about #3240's change) and nothing re-derived it, so it went false while reading exactly as live. It is the sixth instance, and it is in `AGENTS.md` itself. Worth citing in the PR body; ⛔ not worth folding the two PRs over.

## Default-tier review of the wording — `domain:devx @ objectui` dev seat, on branch `claude/issue-7833-agents-verified-claim-rule`

Draft PR objectui#9079 is open. The contract-review tier this card's thread originally asked for was lifted at the tier notice above, on a maintainer ruling; this is the review of record for the wording, at the **default tier**, and it is deliberately posted on the card rather than only on the PR so the ruling and its review sit together.

⛔ This is a review, not an approval: the PR is a governed surface, it stays in draft, and a human merge is its approval record. No approving review has been or will be left on it by this seat.

### What was reviewed

The one bullet landed as commandment `#9` at the end of section 5, plus a changeset with empty frontmatter. Nothing else is in the diff.

### Findings

**1. The rule does not commit the defect it names — checked, not assumed.** The text carries no count of anything. The evidence is reached by address (`objectui#7833`, `objectui#7800`), and a card number does not rot the way a measurement does. Run against the narrow pattern the objectui#7448 twins pin — a numeral qualifying a document-population noun, with issue references excluded by construction — the bullet has no numeral at all outside those references. This mattered more than it looks: a rule stated as 「五个实例」 would have been an instance of itself, landing in the most-read file in the repo.

**2. It is a principle plus a shape, ⛔ not a mechanism and ⛔ not a checklist.** The ruled core — point at the instrument, never write its answer — is stated once and then given exactly two worked forms ("the count this gate prints", not the count; "the list this script enumerates", not the list). It prescribes no procedure, adds no gate, and asks nothing of CI. That is the shape the ruling asked for and it is the part the maintainer finalises.

**3. The clause carrying the most weight is the third one, and it is the one worth reading twice.** 「A figure that is still correct is the dangerous case, not the safe one」 — that is objectui#7448's lesson generalised: the failure mode is not a wrong number, it is a true-when-written assertion nothing re-derives, and spot-checking confirms it. Without that clause a reader concludes "so keep the numbers accurate", which is the response that has already failed here several times over.

**4. The self-reference is load-bearing, not decoration.** 「This file is not exempt」 is a measured claim, verified on this tree before it was written: objectui#7800's own defect was a sentence in this file asserting 「和 CI 同一个结论」, true when written about objectui#3240's change, re-derived by nothing, false while still reading as live. Its repair is in `main` and in this branch's base. ⭐ And the commit this branch is cut from, objectui#9076, is a further instance that landed after the card was filed — a gate header restating a ceiling and a baseline as literals after an authorised re-baseline moved both constants, with nothing going red 「because nothing fails on a number written in a comment」. The card measured this; the repo kept producing it while the card sat.

**5. Placement was decided before language, ⛔ not after.** Section 5's commandment `#-1` scopes English-only to the codebase and enumerates 「code comments, docs」 — which is precisely the artefact set this rule governs — and grants Chinese only to this file's *operational sections*. Section 5 is not one of those, so a rule placed there is English and a rule placed in section 9 is Chinese. ⚠️ Section 9 is a genuinely defensible alternative and the strongest counter-argument to what landed: it already carries the *read-time* half of this same principle (「没跑对照的空结果不是一次读数」, 「每次发布后回读」), and the objectui#7800 repair landed its corrective rule there. The case for section 5 is that this is the *write-time* half and must reach contributors who never open those subsections. That trade is the maintainer's to settle and it is option **B** in the 维护者速读 on the PR.

### Residual risk this review does not clear

⚠️ **Nothing re-derives this rule's own claims** — it is prose in an instruction file, and no gate reads it. The rule is honest about that class of writing but cannot escape it; the population-noun pin governs specific gate headers, ⛔ not this file. ⇒ the only instrument standing behind commandment `#9` is a reader. Widening that pin over `AGENTS.md` was ⛔ **not** done here and ⛔ is not in this card's scope: it would be a new gate on the most-edited governed file in the repo, weighed on its own card, not smuggled in under a wording change.

**Verdict: the wording is sound and the diff is minimal; the open question is placement, and it is a question for the maintainer, not a defect.**

## ACCEPT — PR objectui#9079, and it stops here: draft, ⛔ no landing pipeline for this seat

`domain:devx @ objectui` PM seat (`session_01FhBNJcLRZLe8M87VcUgpKr`), 2026-09-10T23:47Z. Reviewed against the diff, ⛔ not against the report's summary of it. **Two files, +9 / −0** — one bullet in `AGENTS.md`, one changeset. Head `236b24033`, base `origin/main` = `3984bab5a`.

### ⭐ The rule keeps its own rule, and that was measured rather than admired

The whole point of failing this card would have been to land a rule against stale figures **with a figure in it** — 「五个实例」 in the most-read file in the repo. Read mechanically out of the added line, every numeral it contains:

| token | what it is |
|:--|:--|
| `#9` | its own ordinal in the list |
| `objectui#7833` ×2 · `objectui#7800` | ⭐ **addresses**, not measurements |

⇒ **zero** counts, zero sizes, zero populations. The evidence table stays on the card and the rule **points at it**. ⛔ Not asserted from the report — counted out of the landed line.

### ⛔ Boundaries held, verified

| check | reading |
|:--|:--|
| draft | **`true`** ✅ |
| auto-merge | **`null`** ✅ |
| reviews on the pull request | **0** ⇒ ⛔ no seat-side approval exists ✅ |
| files touched | **2**, ⛔ no mixed diff ✅ |
| changeset frontmatter | **empty** — this repo's explicit no-release declaration ✅ |
| `Governed Surface Queue Guard` | `completed` / `success` — ⚠️ and that is its `pull_request` leg, which **exits 0 deliberately**; ⛔ green is not permission ✅ |
| CI on the head | 33 check-runs, 30 success, 3 skipped, **0 failing** |

⚠️ The `documentation` label on the pull request was ⛔ **not** set by this lane. It was left alone: state on a shared identity that this seat did not set belongs to another actor.

### ⛔ My own premise was wrong, and the dev caught it — on this card, of all cards

My dispatch order's premise 1 said `AGENTS.md` carries 「**twelve** numbered top-level sections (`## 0.` … `## 9.`)」. Measured: **ten**. ⭐ The sentence even falsified itself in its own parenthesis — `0` through `9` is ten — and I wrote it into the order for the one card whose entire subject is *a count that no instrument re-derives*. ⇒ recorded here rather than quietly dropped, because that is the behaviour this rule is asking of everyone else. ⛔ No repo change is owed; the file is fine.

### ⭐ A seventh instance, and it is the commit this branch was cut from

The dev verified before citing: **objectui#9076** — landed 20 minutes before this branch existed — repaired a gate header that restated a ceiling and a baseline as literals after an authorised re-baseline moved both constants. ⇒ the card was written with five, `AGENTS.md` itself supplied the sixth (objectui#7800), and the **seventh arrived while this card was being dispatched**. ⛔ Nothing filed: it is already fixed.

### ⛔ What was deliberately NOT done, and stays not done

⚠️ **Nothing re-derives commandment `#9` itself.** The population-noun pin governs specific gate headers, ⛔ not this file. Widening it over `AGENTS.md` would put a new gate on the most-edited governed file in the repo — ⛔ a decision, not a defect, and it depends on wording the maintainer has not finalised. ⇒ ⛔ not filed now, and ⛔ not smuggled in under a wording change. It is durable in the dev's review above as its 「Residual risk」 paragraph; this seat files it bare **after** the wording settles, if it is still wanted.

## ⛔ The terminal state — this is where the seat stops

`AGENTS.md` is governed surface. ⛔ This seat will not flip it ready, will not enqueue it, will not auto-merge it, will not merge it, and ⛔ will not leave an approving review on it. **The human's merge is the review record.** The four terminal acts are done: the dev's default-tier wording review on this card, `needs-user-decision` + 「维护者速读」 on the pull request, review requested from `os-zhuang` and `hotlong`, and the pull request left in **draft**.

⚠️ The maintainer's answer is one letter — **A** (as landed: section 5, commandment `#9`, English), **B** (section 9, Chinese), **C** (shorter wording), or **D** (edit the text on the pull request directly; `maintainer_can_modify` is on).

⇒ objectui#8875 PR 2 — the cite-by-content convention text, also `AGENTS.md` — stays serialised behind this one and its card stays open with its claim intact.
